# unset

> Immutably unset a value at a path in a document using structural sharing.

<!-- Section to include introductory text. Make sure to keep an empty line after the intro `section` element and another before the `/section` close. -->

<section class="intro">

This function immutably unsets a value at a specified path in a document. Only objects and arrays along the path are shallow-cloned; all other subtrees retain their original references (structural sharing).

</section>

<!-- /.intro -->

<!-- Package usage documentation. -->

<section class="usage">

## Usage

```javascript
var unset = require( '@stdlib/utils/json-patch/base/unset' );
```

#### unset( document, tokens )

Immutably unsets a value at a path in a document using structural sharing.

```javascript
var doc = {
    'a': {
        'b': 1,
        'c': 2
    }
};
var out = unset( doc, [ 'a', 'b' ] );
// returns { 'a': { 'c': 2 } }

var bool = ( doc.a === out.a );
// returns false

bool = ( doc === out );
// returns false
```

```javascript
var doc = {
    'a': [ 1, 2, 3 ]
};
var out = unset( doc, [ 'a', '1' ] );
// returns { 'a': [ 1, 3 ] }
```

</section>

<!-- /.usage -->

<!-- Package usage notes. Make sure to keep an empty line after the `section` element and another before the `/section` close. -->

<section class="notes">

## Notes

-   Only objects and arrays along the path are shallow-cloned. All other subtrees keep their original references (structural sharing).
-   The function throws an `Error` if `tokens` is empty (cannot unset the root of a document).
-   The function throws an `Error` if any token is an unsafe value (e.g., `__proto__`, `constructor`).
-   The function throws a `TypeError` if an intermediate path segment references a non-traversable value (e.g., a string or number).

</section>

<!-- /.notes -->

<!-- Package usage examples. -->

<section class="examples">

## Examples

<!-- eslint no-undef: "error" -->

```javascript
var unset = require( '@stdlib/utils/json-patch/base/unset' );

// Unset a value at a shallow path:
var doc = {
    'a': 1,
    'b': 2
};
var out = unset( doc, [ 'a' ] );
console.log( out );
/* =>
    {
        'b': 2
    }
*/

// Unset a value at a deep path:
doc = {
    'a': {
        'b': {
            'c': 1,
            'd': 2
        }
    }
};
out = unset( doc, [ 'a', 'b', 'c' ] );
console.log( out );
/* =>
    {
        'a': {
            'b': {
                'd': 2
            }
        }
    }
*/

// Unset an element from an array:
doc = {
    'x': [ 'a', 'b', 'c' ]
};
out = unset( doc, [ 'x', '1' ] );
console.log( out );
/* =>
    {
        'x': [ 'a', 'c' ]
    }
*/

// Structural sharing (unchanged subtrees keep references):
doc = {
    'a': {
        'b': 1,
        'c': 2
    },
    'd': {
        'e': 3
    }
};
out = unset( doc, [ 'a', 'b' ] );
console.log( out.d === doc.d );
// => true
```

</section>

<!-- /.examples -->
